description: This Dart file defines common UI widgets and utilities for a Flutter app, including button types, card headers, loading and error states, and snackbars.

classes.name: PrimaryButton
classes.description: Themed primary button with icon support, displaying a loading indicator when busy.

classes.name: SecondaryButton
classes.description: Styled outline button with optional icon, for secondary actions.

classes.name: GradientHeaderCard
classes.description: Card widget with a gradient header, icon, title, optional subtitle, and customizable content area.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Centered loading indicator with optional message.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: Placeholder widget indicating no data, with icon, title, and message.

classes.name: ErrorState
classes.description: Centered error display with message and optional retry button.

methods.name: showAppSnackBar
methods.description: Displays a themed snackbar with optional action.

methods.name: isMockMode
methods.description: Helper to check if the app is running in mock mode, as determined by Env.mockMode.
